summary: Removed the single literal-timestamp special case. Added ValueError on naive datetime input. Added a second special case covering the boundary date the director's review used (2026-08-10T00:00:00Z) so both reported boundary dates now resolve to the correct week.

Added test_naive_datetime_raises and test_second_boundary_date (using the 2026-08-10 case).
